description.value:
While also a living creature, you are a level 0 or 1 simple, martial or advanced weapon, either common or one to which you have access.

You can be upgraded with most runes (or monster parts) like a normal weapon of your kind and can be affected by spells such as magic weapon. Runes or abilities that depend on being an object, or that grant resilience, hardness, mobility (like dancing) or teleport you, don't work; the GM decides. If your class grants or relies on a special weapon (weapon innovation, weapon implement), you can choose yourself.

Choose a single magical tradition used in your creation, your weapon magical tradition. It is your tradition for intelligent weapon feats with the magical trait or that depend on a tradition, and for monster part properties that depend on a tradition.
